import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = 1000000007;
    static int K;
    static long N;
    static List<Integer> num = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[][][] base = new long[60][30][];
    static long[][][] pref = new long[60][30][];
    static long[][][] suf = new long[60][30][];
    static long[][] trans;

    static long[][] matMul(long[][] a, long[][] b) {
        int size = a.length;
        long[][] res = new long[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                res[i][j] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < size; k++) {
                    res[i][j] += a[i][k] * b[k][j];
                }
                res[i][j] %= INF;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long[][] shift(long[][] a, int x) {
        int size = a.length;
        long[][] res = new long[size][size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] == 0) continue;
                if (i == j) {
                    res[i][j] = a[i][j];
                } else {
                    res[i][(j + x) % K] = a[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        while (N != 0) {
            num.add((int)(N % K));
            N /= K;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            base[0][i] = new long[K + 1][K + 1];
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                base[0][i][j] = new long[K + 1];
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                base[0][i][j][j] = 1;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                base[0][i][j][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < num.size(); i++) {
            pref[i - 1][0] = base[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                pref[i - 1][j] = matMul(pref[i - 1][j - 1], base[i - 1][j]);
            }
            suf[i - 1][K - 1] = base[i - 1][K - 1];
            for (int j = K - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                suf[i - 1][j] = matMul(base[i - 1][j], suf[i - 1][j + 1]);
            }
            base[i][0] = pref[i - 1][K - 1];
            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                base[i][j] = matMul(suf[i - 1][j], pref[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }
        }

        trans = new long[K + 1][K + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(trans[i], 0);
            trans[i][i] = 1;
        }

        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = num.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int x = num.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < x; j++) {
                trans = matMul(trans, base[i][sum]);
                sum++;
                if (sum >= K) sum -= K;
            }
        }

        long ans = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            ans += trans[K][i];
            ans %= INF;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
